hero.headline: Helping you find your fit in Charlotte
hero.summary: The right home is not just about square footage or price. It should fit your life. Inga helps you make sense of the neighborhoods, numbers, paperwork, and choices so you can feel good about what comes next.

about.workingStyle: Straight answers, plain English, and help finding the move that fits your life.
about.headline: Finding the right fit starts with feeling understood.
paragraphs: The right move looks different for everyone. My first job is to listen: where you are now, what matters to you, and what you want daily life to feel like after the boxes are unpacked.

I work with clients across Charlotte and the surrounding areas. You should never feel like you need to speak real estate to understand what is happening. My job is to explain the terms, lay out the choices, and help you find the home, neighborhood, or next step that fits.

services.headline: Find the move that fits where you are now.
services.summary: Whether you are buying, selling, moving to Charlotte, or thinking about a rental, Inga starts with what matters to you and makes the process easier to understand.

items.title: Buying a home
items.description: Find a home and neighborhood that fit your budget, routines, and plans, then understand the offer, inspections, and deadlines before you sign.

items.title: Selling a home
items.description: Make a selling plan that fits your timing and priorities: what to fix, what to skip, how to price, and how to compare offers without the jargon.

items.title: Moving to Charlotte
items.description: Find the part of the Charlotte area that fits your daily life by comparing commutes, school assignments, routines, and the feel of each community.

items.title: Thinking about a rental
items.description: Decide whether renting fits your plans by asking about the rules, costs, insurance, upkeep, and day-to-day work before you count on the income.
